caption: A bottle cap spun on a kitchen counter spins in place, slows, and rattles to a stop.

sa.check: A bottle cap is spun on a kitchen counter.
The spin comes first, then the slowing, then the stop.

pc.expect: It slows steadily and wobbles more as it slows.
pc.fail: It speeds up; or the wobble shrinks; or it stops instantly.

pc.expect: Nothing touches it after the spin.
pc.fail: It is driven along; or reverses; or restarts.

pc.expect: It stays on the counter and settles flat.
pc.fail: It lifts; or hangs on its edge; or floats.

pc.expect: The cap is rigid and rattles.
pc.fail: It bends; or melts; or splits.
It duplicates; or vanishes; or turns into another object.

pc.expect: Everything in view, named in the caption or not, keeps its number, identity and shape unless something visible acts on it, and nothing passes through anything else.
pc.fail: An object that nothing visible acts on appears from nothing; or vanishes while still in frame and not occluded; or duplicates or merges with another; or turns into a different object or a different shape between frames; or any object passes through another. Changes brought about by the caption's event or by a visible interaction, objects leaving the frame, and occlusion are not failures.

pc.expect: The cap and the counter stay the same.
pc.fail: The cap changes colour; or the counter changes; or the kitchen rearranges.
